Game Overview

In Moto Maniac, the core idea is straightforward: master the art of balance in Moto Maniac, a thrilling off-road biking adventure. Conquer wildly uneven terrains brimming with logs and unexpected slopes. Test your skills with precision controls and patience as you race to the finish, striving to keep your bike upright and your nerves in check.
